title: THE FORGE: FIRE ROUNDS BURN
why: His idea of 2026-10-12: upgrade guns and add elemental damage. FIRE is the first element. A round from a MK III fire gun (every round of a Burst Carbine burst too) sets what it hits burning for 3 seconds, about a quarter of the hit again each second (at most 18 a second; armour does not stop fire), and a body the burn finishes is your kill, with the contracts, the kill feed and the score as for a round. A pillager hit by fire panics: he runs straight away from you for about a second and fires nothing, then fights on (once every 5 seconds). Machines burn and keep fighting. The damage number of a fire round is fire coloured; a weak point stays orange. No gun can be upgraded in play yet: the Forge station comes in a later build.
now: Fire rounds from a MK III gun burn their target and make pillagers panic.
